sections.text_helper: Section 26.5 "RNG processing time" in chapter 26 (True random number generator (RNG)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 783.
sections.section_content:
In the recommended configuration described in Table199, the time between two sets of four
32-bit data is either:
• 206 x N AHB cycles if fAHB < fthreshold (conditioning stage is limiting), or
• 128 x N RNG cycles fAHB ≥ fthreshold (noise source stage is limiting).
If fRNG= 48 MHz, fthreshold = 1.6 x fRNG = 77 MHz. The value of N is defined in Section26.6.
Note: When CLKDIV is different from 0, fRNG must take into account the internal divider ratio.
